description: How the roles around the formulation-to-production chain relate to each other: who releases recipes to whom, how quality gates batches, who buys and funds the platform, and which feedback loops connect plants, executives, vendor teams, and education.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Selling, licensing, and expanding platform subscriptions

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day formulation, production, quality release, and support

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Test results, market signals, performance reporting, and product feedback

relations.name: Releases recipes to production
relations.description: Hands approved recipe versions and formulation constraints to production so the plant runs against the current, validated formula rather than an outdated copy.

relations.name: Signals ingredient price and supply changes
relations.description: Flags raw material price moves, supplier changes, and availability risks so the nutritionist can reformulate quickly instead of discovering the change at intake.

relations.name: Sets ingredient specifications to buy against
relations.description: Defines the nutritional and quality specs each ingredient must meet, giving procurement the frame for supplier selection and risk-adjusted buying.

relations.name: Submits batches for testing and release
relations.description: Registers produced batches with process data and samples so quality can run the test plan and build the traceability record.

relations.name: Releases or blocks batches
relations.description: Gates each batch against specifications, releasing conforming product and blocking deviations with corrective actions before they leave the plant.

relations.name: Feeds test results into formulation
relations.description: Returns lab results and ingredient analysis data so formulation works with measured nutrient values instead of stale table values.

relations.name: Provisions and integrates formulation tools
relations.description: Keeps the formulation and quality applications available, secured, and integrated with ERP and plant systems so master data flows without manual re-entry.

relations.name: Sets margin and standardization targets
relations.description: Translates profitability and cross-site standardization goals into cost and quality targets that formulation optimizes against.

relations.name: Reports production performance
relations.description: Reports yield, losses, downtime, and deviation trends upward so the executive sees what is changing across sites without waiting for month-end.

relations.name: Reports environmental impact transparently
relations.description: Publishes sustainability reporting on footprint, waste, and sourcing built from traceable production data, answering environmental accountability with evidence.

relations.name: Sells and expands subscriptions
relations.description: Sells the platform to the economic buyer with value stories and proof, and expands the footprint site by site once results land.

relations.name: Funds licenses and renewals
relations.description: Pays subscription and license fees and decides at renewal whether the measured margin and standardization gains justify continued investment.

relations.name: Onboards and supports power users
relations.description: Onboards nutritionists and plant users, resolves incidents fast, and drives adoption of new capabilities so daily formulation work never stalls.

relations.name: Feeds product feedback and needs
relations.description: Channels formulation pain points, data-quality gaps, and feature requests — directly and via customer care — into the vendor's roadmap decisions.

relations.name: Funds roadmap investment
relations.description: Allocates budget to the highest-leverage product initiatives and holds the product team to adoption and growth outcomes.

relations.name: Equips sales with value stories
relations.description: Supplies positioning, proof points, and release narratives that give sales a credible, low-friction buying motion for new and existing accounts.

relations.name: Teaches with formulation tools
relations.description: Runs courses and research projects on the formulation and optimization tools so students learn on the same software the industry uses.

relations.name: Licenses academic program access
relations.description: Provides universities and research centers with academic licensing so curricula stay industry-aligned and graduates arrive tool-ready.
